steps_resize-image_1Desc: Select an image to resize. Supported formats include JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, and HEIC. Your original stays untouched on your device.
steps_resize-image_2Desc: Enter the desired width and height in pixels. Toggle aspect ratio lock to maintain proportions or unlock for custom dimensions. Choose a preset size for common uses.
steps_resize-image_3Desc: Click Resize to generate the downsized (or upsized) image. Download the result — perfect for web optimization, social media, or email attachments.
desc: Resize images to any dimension instantly. Supports all major image formats.
invalidSize: Enter a valid target size (1-16384 pixels)
